description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractParser' within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class provides the structure for parsing API responses from AWS services, including reference to the service description and abstract methods for processing command responses and stream data.

classes.name: AbstractParser
classes.description: An abstract base class for parsing responses from AWS service APIs.

methods.description: Initializes the parser with the AWS service API description.

methods.description: Abstract method to parse the command execution response into a ResultInterface.
